page_title: WER 0-1 FRE | Werder Bremen v Freiburg 05/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+52' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) picks up a yellow card.
90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' The resulting set piece from Werder Bremen is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+6' The referee points to the corner flag and Werder Bremen will take a corner.

90+6' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Noah Atubolu anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the bottom left corner.
90+5' What a huge chance for Lucas Holer (Freiburg). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
90+4' Tobias Welz shows a yellow card to Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen) for his blatant foul.
90+4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Werder Bremen comes to nothing.
90+3' The referee signals a corner kick to Werder Bremen.
90+3' Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

90+2' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Noah Atubolu pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going inside the right-hand post.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
87' Werder Bremen can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
87' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) decides to have a shot at goal from the free kick, but it hits the defensive wall.
86' Anthony Jung goes off the pitch and Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) comes on.
86' Ole Werner has decided to make a change. Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) replaces Jens Stage.
85' Werder Bremen win a direct free kick in a dangerous mid-range position.
85' Referee Tobias Welz sees the trip by Junior Adamu (Freiburg) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
83' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Patrick Osterhage as he is replaced by Lucas Holer (Freiburg).
83' Julian Schuster decides to make a substitution. Christian Gunter will be replaced by Jordy Makengo (Freiburg).
82' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Werder Bremen.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Felix Agu departs the field of play to be replaced by Marco Grull (Werder Bremen).
79' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Derrick Kohn is replaced by Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen).
77' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Vincenzo Grifo walks off the pitch to be replaced by Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg).
75' 0 - 1 Goal! Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) gets a shot away from inside the box and the effort is deflected past the goalkeeper. 0:1.
73' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
70' Shots on target – 2:2.
66' Eren Dinkci has picked up an injury and is replaced by Florent Muslija (Freiburg).
66' Julian Schuster has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) replacing Lukas Kubler.
65' The game is interrupted now, Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
65' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
64' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) but poses no threat.
64' Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
60' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
58' Here comes a substitution. Skelly Alvero is given a rest as he is replaced by Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen).
57' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
56' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) reacts well to meet the lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but sends a weak header well wide of the right post.

53' That didn't go as planned! Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Michael Zetterer, who easily kept it out.
50' The Freiburg players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45+1' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the right post and flies out of play.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
43' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. It's a throw-in for Werder Bremen.
42' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
40' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
40' Fouls committed – 1:3.
36' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
33' Good work from Freiburg as they win a corner.
33' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Freiburg.

33' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.

29' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Michael Zetterer tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
26' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
24' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) takes the corner with a short pass.
24' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
23' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) is penalised for a foul. Tobias Welz had a clear view and blows his whistle. Werder Bremen get a free kick.
20' A quickly taken corner by Werder Bremen.
20' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
17' A pass into the box finds Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Noah Atubolu denies him.
15' A pass by Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
12' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands.
9' Freiburg players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
6' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
3' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) takes the corner which is cleared.
3' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Freiburg will take the kick-off.
Tobias Welz got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
